name: best-of-amravati-workspace
description: Best of Amravati Monorepo Workspace - Frontend, Admin Dashboard, and API Gateway

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "FRONTEND,ADMIN,API" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold,yellow.bold" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix bestofamravati.com && npm run build --prefix admin.bestofamravati.com
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix bestofamravati.com && npm install --prefix admin.bestofamravati.com && npm install --prefix api.bestofamravati.com
